name: CI trust boundary guard
summary: Block newly introduced high-confidence CI credential and execution privilege expansions.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate for Write and Edit that reconstructs bounded CI configuration changes and blocks only net-new broad write authority, credential persistence or inheritance, untrusted-trigger secret exposure, privileged execution, and host runtime socket access across recognized CI configuration paths.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks newly introduced high-confidence CI credential and execution privilege expansions; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not execute, validate, rewrite, approve, or submit a CI workflow or pipeline.
It does not claim complete YAML semantics or silently claim support for an unrecognized CI provider.
It does not infer approval from comments, prompt text, branch names, environment variables, or project-authored exception files.
It does not reveal secret expressions, workflow commands, credential values, or inspected file content in block messages.

entrypoints.purpose: Reconstruct bounded CI changes and deterministically reject net-new high-confidence trust expansions.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block newly introduced high-confidence CI credential and execution privilege expansions without deferred work.
